authority: Malibu Municipal Code Ch. 17.53 (Fire-Resistant Landscaping); Ordinance No. 361
scope: citywide; five-foot ember-resistant zone around structures
note: Hedges and flammable fences/walls prohibited within five feet of a building; effective date is the California Coastal Commission's LCP certification date, since Malibu's fire rules are also Local Coastal Program amendments. A further restriction on attached combustible fences/gates within five feet of a structure took effect 2024-01-01 per the city's own posting; not yet confirmed against a specific ordinance number.
